tagline.en: Better to light a candle with my own hands than to curse the darkness.

chips.en: Spot the pain point, build the fix

about.zh: 剛認識我的時候，你可能會覺得我有點安靜。其實我很喜歡聊天，也喜歡聽別人分享各種故事。
about.en: When you first meet me, I might seem a little quiet. In truth, I love a good conversation and enjoy hearing people's stories.

about.zh: 我是一個喜歡思考、習慣把事情拆開來追根究柢的人。這個習慣也延伸到我的手作：車縫、鈎織、拼圖，一針一線重複的過程讓我很容易專注、進入深度思考，也讓我更有耐心面對需要長時間投入的事。
about.en: I like to think things through and take problems apart until I reach the root. The same habit carries into my handcrafts: sewing, crochet, jigsaw puzzles. Working stitch by stitch helps me focus, think deeply, and stay patient with things that take time.

about.zh: 自己動手做過，才知道一件衣服、一頂毛帽背後要花多少時間和材料。這讓我更珍惜手上的東西，能修就修、能改就改，也很自然地在意材料有沒有被浪費。對我來說，手作和永續是同一種生活態度：慢一點，讓每樣東西都被好好用到最後。我曾在永續社群裡織毛帽送給偏鄉長者，也用學校回收的木材做過一個小木架；這些經驗讓我相信，很多東西不是沒有價值，只是還沒被放到對的地方。
about.en: Making things by hand taught me how much time and material go into a single garment or a knitted hat. It makes me value what I have, mend and rework rather than replace, and care about whether materials go to waste. To me, handcraft and sustainability are the same way of living: slow down, and let everything be used well to the very end. I have knitted hats for elderly residents of rural communities through a sustainability group, and built a small shelf from wood my school was discarding. These experiences convinced me that many things are not without value; they just haven't been put in the right place yet.

about.zh: 我也相信，再好的構想都要真正落地才有意義，所以我很喜歡從身邊的不方便出發：看見一個痛點，就想親手做出一個東西把它解決。媽媽準備檢定考時找不到順手的練習方式，我就用 Claude 做了一個刷題網站，她最後順利考過，只錯一題。看到自己做的東西真的幫到人，是我最有成就感的時刻。
about.en: I also believe even the best idea only matters once it truly lands. So I like to start from the small inconveniences around me: when I see a pain point, I want to build something that fixes it. When my mother couldn't find a good way to practice for a certification exam, I built a practice-quiz website with Claude. She passed, missing only one question. Seeing something I made genuinely help someone is what makes me proudest.

about.zh: 遇到跟不上的時候，我會誠實面對自己卡在哪裡，去問、去換方法，而不是悶著頭硬撐。我相信能力不是天生的，是願意一直找方法的人慢慢磨出來的。
about.en: When I fall behind, I'm honest about where I'm stuck. I ask questions and try a different approach instead of struggling in silence. I believe ability isn't innate; it is built, slowly, by people who keep looking for a better way.

about.zh: 我嚮往寧靜踏實的生活，希望有一天能住在鄉下，種菜、做手作。在那之前，我想先把自己的能力，用在讓更多好的構想真正落地。
about.en: I dream of a quiet, grounded life, someday in the countryside, growing vegetables and making things by hand. Until then, I want to put my abilities toward helping more good ideas truly take root.

bullets.en: Led the business model and financial projections; validated demand through a survey of family caregivers and in-depth interviews, and estimated the break-even point and the number of contracts needed to reach 100,000 users. Integrated market, regulatory, and financial analysis to keep the channel strategy, timeline, and financial model consistent.

meta.zh: AI 協作開發・累計 5 位以上使用者

text.zh: 為協助母親準備檢定考試，我從她的實際練習需求出發規劃功能，並運用 Claude 協作開發這個刷題平台。母親以此平台備考，最終順利通過檢定，僅錯一題；其後經她推薦給同學使用，目前累計使用者已超過五位。主要功能包括：PDF、CSV、JSON 題本匯入與題目自動辨識、依分類設定出題比例、錯題自動記錄與專項練習，並支援手機操作。
text.en: To help my mother prepare for a certification exam, I designed features around how she actually practiced and built this platform in collaboration with Claude. She studied with it and passed, missing only one question; she then recommended it to classmates, and it now has more than five users. Features include importing question banks from PDF, CSV, or JSON with automatic question recognition, setting question ratios by category, automatic tracking of wrong answers with targeted review, and mobile support.

meta.zh: AI 協作開發・與 Claude 一起做
meta.en: Built with AI · made with Claude

text.zh: 自己設計需求、和 Claude 一起開發的專案與時間管理工具。同一份資料可以切換成今日待辦、行事曆、任務清單、艾森豪矩陣和甘特圖來看；任務可以分層、標示進度，也能和 Google 日曆同步。
text.en: A project and time management tool I designed and built with Claude. The same data can be viewed as today's to-dos, a calendar, a task list, an Eisenhower matrix, or a Gantt chart; tasks can be nested and marked by status, and it syncs with Google Calendar.
